metadata.task_goal: Establish a documented disposition for a respiratory PCR result using clinical context, specimen material, and assay evidence.

files./workspace/lab/request.txt:
RESULT REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2301
An emergency team asks about a respiratory PCR result under reference MD-V3-2301. The result queue shows a positive SARS-CoV-2 target.
files./workspace/lab/current.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2301
The patient has fever and cough. A rapid antigen test from triage was negative. No prior respiratory molecular result is recorded during this encounter.
files./workspace/lab/specimen.txt:
SPECIMEN MATERIAL
The nasopharyngeal swab label matches the electronic patient identifiers. Collection was documented at 09:04; laboratory receipt is 12:46. The receiving record notes an unsealed outer transport pouch.
files./workspace/lab/evidence.txt:
ASSAY EVIDENCE
The molecular panel detected SARS-CoV-2 at a high cycle threshold. Internal control passed. The instrument log records a repeat run that was cancelled after an insufficient residual volume flag.
files./workspace/lab/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a request, clinical record, specimen material, and assay evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
